title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
abstract: arXiv:2611.06483v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

translated_title: 多轮强化学习究竟在LLM智能体中提升了什么？
translated_abstract: 虽然多轮智能体强化学习（RL）在长程任务上表现出色，但其性能提升对交互约束仍然高度敏感。通过Pass@(K,T)在采样广度K和交互深度T上进行评估，我们表明轨迹层面的RL优势依赖于充足的轮次预算，当预算收紧时该优势会显著减弱。此外，智能体RL并非均匀地提升单步决策质量；相反，其优势集中在错误恢复和长程韧性上。为缓解这种预算依赖带来的部署风险，我们对过程监督信号的益处与局限性进行了初步讨论，并引入BudgetMix RL作为替代方案，该方案在训练期间改变交互预算。实验表明，BudgetMix RL在多种执行设置下均能取得稳健的性能。项目主页：https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/
tldr: 本文通过Pass@(K,T)评估发现多轮智能体强化学习的优势依赖充足的交互轮次预算，且主要体现在错误恢复与长程韧性而非单步决策质量上，进而提出在训练中动态改变交互预算的BudgetMix RL，以在多种执行设置下实现稳健性能。
en_tdlr: This paper shows via Pass@(K,T) evaluation that multi-turn agentic RL gains depend on sufficient turn budgets and mainly stem from error recovery and long-horizon resilience rather than single-step decision quality, and proposes BudgetMix RL—which varies interaction budgets during training—to achieve robust performance across diverse execution settings.
